visa.requirements.notes: Apply at least four weeks ahead.
visa.requirements.disclaimer: Entry rules change; the embassy has the final word.

assistance.title: UK visitor visa assistance
assistance.summary: We check and submit your application.
assistance.governmentFeeNote: The government fee is paid separately.

recorded.answer: Yes, a visa is required, and you should apply at least four weeks ahead.
